contract.factory: createSceneLibrary({ document, window, sceneDirector, onSelect, onSave, storage } = {})
returns: installSidebar({host, scenePanel, dataPanel, advanced = true, initialTab = "scenes", expanded = true} = {})

callbacks.onSave: onSave(namedScene, {sceneDirector}) -> Scene | void | Promise; false/throw/reject reports failure. Caller handles persistence when supplied.
callbacks.onSelect: onSelect(scene, {sceneDirector, saved:true}) -> void | Promise; false/throw/reject reports failure. Caller applies scene to director.

contract.storage: Optional adapter {list(): Scene[] | Promise<Scene[]>, save(scene): Scene | void | Promise}. Raw localStorage is intentionally not parsed; wrap Agent7 storage helper or supply callbacks.
contract.install: Constructor is detached; coordinator calls installSidebar AFTER SceneDirector initialization. Existing non-incident controls move into native collapsed details; existing incident playback remains in place. No own playback, subscriptions, fake data, CSS, or director mutations.

behavior: Constructor creates detached DOM without touching existing sidebar
Empty state and disabled save/name controls
Active count/location/provenance and untrusted title rendered as text
Editable name and native form submit save a copy, preserve source and show success
Saved scene selection delegates to caller and displays selected scene
Opt-in installation preserves existing control identity/listeners and keeps incident playback outside collapsed advanced details
Scenes/Layers tabs toggle panels and support Home key focus with ARIA states
Drawer toggle and Escape synchronize visibility, expansion and focus
Idempotent destroy removes owned DOM/listeners and restores original panels/control order
Save rejection is caught, announced and recoverable
Stale asynchronous save cannot overwrite a newly active scene
External renderSaved takes precedence over stale asynchronous storage hydration
Pending selection after destroy has no DOM side effects
tests.harness: Inline Node assert + minimal DOM stand-in; no real-browser visual validation.

limitations: Coordinator must wire callbacks to Agent7 persistence helper and SceneDirector; this module does not select/play scenes itself.
Styles and responsive drawer layout belong to Agents11/12 and were not changed.
Existing independent panel-disclosure controllers are not subscribed to; coordinator should centralize disclosure ownership when installing tabs.
No full-app build or browser visual checks performed by this scoped subagent.
